definitions.explanation: Money paid for the use of borrowed money, or earned on deposited money.

examples.japanese: {利息|りそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利息|りそく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利息|りそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{預|あず}ける→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{利息|りそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: If you deposit money at a bank, you earn interest.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{利息|りそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you borrow at this interest rate, the amount you repay will become very large.

notes:
{利息|りそく} refers to the money earned on savings or paid on loans — the actual amount of interest, not the percentage rate.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {利息|りそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to earn/accrue interest
- {利息|りそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay interest
- {利息|りそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive interest
- {利息|りそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: interest is high/low

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{利子|りし}→利子：17606_rishi⟧: interest (virtually synonymous; ⟦{利子|りし}→利子：17606_rishi⟧ is slightly more formal and common in written/legal contexts)
- ⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧: interest rate (the percentage, not the money amount)
- ⟦{利率|りりつ}→利率：21159_riritsu⟧: interest rate (more technical/formal than ⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧)

USAGE:
{利息|りそく} applies to both interest earned on deposits and interest charged on loans. Context makes clear which is meant. In Japan's long era of low interest rates, {利息|りそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦つかない→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (earning almost no interest) has been a common complaint about bank savings.
